entries.title: Doc Coauthoring supplied-snapshot adaptation
uses: Draft and revise proposals, specifications, decision records, and internal communications from supplied context, then test whether the intended reader can understand and act on them. Use for substantive writing rather than file-format manipulation.
entries.description: Draft and revise proposals, specifications, decision records, and internal communications from supplied context, then test whether the intended reader can understand and act on them. Use for substantive writing rather than file-format manipulation.
entries.notes: SOURCES.md identifies a user-supplied snapshot, but records no verified upstream URL or revision. Local rewrites and additions coexist with inherited material; this entry does not assign the inherited license to every file.
